summary:
Implemented the Tabs feature. Nothing was run and nothing was committed, so the tests are unverified.

Changes:
- src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (new): Tab, TabsRenderable, and Tabs, with __all__ = ["Tab", "Tabs"]. DEFAULT_STYLES is "height: 2;". The active tab name and bar position are private reactives, and a watcher animates the bar.
- src/textual/renderables/underline_bar.py: adds clickable_ranges before width. Yields one Text, with range_clicked('name') click spans applied last. The zero-width early path has no click spans.
- src/textual/renderables/opacity.py: merges the blended color into each segment's existing style, preserving meta and other attributes.
- tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py and test_opacity.py: new tests appended.
- tests/widgets/test_tabs.py and tests/widgets/__init__.py (new): tab logic, label rows, duplicate names, the no-tabs row, and click metadata.
- docs/reference/tabs.md (new) and sandbox/tabs_demo.py plus tabs_demo.css (new).

Decisions to review:
- Bar position uses displayed-tab indices rather than full-list indices from find_tab_by_name. This matters only with duplicate names, and it keeps the underline under the displayed active tab (acceptance criterion 11).
- Letter search accepts only single-character keys.
- can_focus = True is set on Tabs so it receives key events.
- The layout resolver needed no change: Edge already has size, min_size, and fraction.
- Escape is a no-op because the bare set_focus coroutine is never awaited, as the spec describes. This emits a runtime warning.
- The auto-fit test expectation is hand-derived from the flexible-share arithmetic.
